facts.detail: Five natural lifestyle strategies can increase testosterone levels.
Prioritizing adequate and quality nightly rest.
Restricting dietary intake of refined sugars and processed foods.
Increasing daily consumption or exposure to Vitamin D.
Engaging in consistent physical exercise routines.
